title: A Pressure-Free Virtual Element Method for the Surface Stokes Problem
summary: We develop a pressure-free virtual element method for the surface Stokes problem on polygonal approximations of closed surfaces of arbitrary genus. The method extends the planar VEM Stokes complex to discrete surfaces, yielding a nonconforming complex with an exactly tangential, $H(\operatorname{div})$-conforming velocity space, commuting interpolation, and the correct discrete cohomology.
